caption:
I told him 10 minutes.

Then I found out the door and the ignition don't take the same key. That means you can't make a key the normal way. The whole ignition switch had to come out and get replaced.

That's not a $150 job anymore.

So I told him before he paid. Not after.

Total came to $250. He had $200 on him.

He paid $200.

Would you rather a guy tell you in the middle of the job, or hand you a surprise at the end?
